# Schema15 exploration intent fixture

`schema15-exploration-intents.json` was generated by running `NativeService` and
`build_evidence_view` from main commit `31fd90da8a7634619a1a42b23a62b680f483294d`
in two isolated synthetic projects. Each project publishes one inline text item,
enables exploration, creates a scope and route, then calls exploration_decide
with that publication as the work input. One snapshot includes the input in its
roots and one omits it. The fixture retains the actual workflow_intents row and
the old view whose hash was stored by main. Neither intent has basis_mode.

`test_real_schema15_intents_require_explicit_format_reapproval` verifies the old
view hash, stores these original details in a schema15 project, upgrades it to
schema16, and exercises materialize or launch claim. Both cases require new
approval for the explicit format-upgrade reason. The scope-work-v1 tests cover
only the unreleased E3 round-1 format, independently of this fixture.
